alias: B-Infohub: alarms recovered from the bridge's flash log
description:
Fires when the bridge replays alarms that happened while Home Assistant was down or disconnected -- the gap every other alarm automation has by construction, since they trigger on live entity changes and an alarm that occurred AND cleared during an outage produces no edge.

WORDING IS DELIBERATELY NEUTRAL. An earlier version told the owner the generator 'will not carry an outage until this is cleared at the panel'. The drain cannot know that: it knows a bit was set and whether it is still set, not whether the condition is shutdown-class. Asserting it turned a routine weekly exercise into a critical page saying their standby power was gone.

Severity follows the payload: still-asserted is time-sensitive and worth looking at; all-cleared is history worth knowing and not worth waking anyone for. Neither is critical, because this automation reports the PAST. A condition that is still live and genuinely serious is caught by the shutdown automation, on the live entity, at the time it happens.
